methodologyNotes: Each vendor's official pricing page was re-fetched via WebFetch on 2026-06-15: zoho.com/us/inventory/pricing/, katanamrp.com/pricing/, inflowinventory.com/software-pricing, sortly.com/pricing/, cin7.com/pricing/, fishbowlinventory.com/pricing, ordoro.com/inventory-management-pricing, finaleinventory.com/pricing, extensiv.com/ecosystem/integrations/pricing, brightpearl.com/pricing. Where a page rendered EUR (Zoho /us/), USD figures were corroborated via Capterra/G2 and Zoho's own KB (per-organization flat pricing confirmed: $39/$99/$159/$299 monthly). Finale Inventory's named tiers ($99-$949) were found ONLY on third-party aggregators (Capterra/G2) and are contradicted by the official finaleinventory.com page, which is quote-only (~$499 starting, custom) since the Descartes acquisition — Finale collapsed to a single Custom plan with monthlyUsd=null. Quote-only tiers (Brightpearl all, Cin7 Omni, Fishbowl Advanced, inFlow Enterprise, Sortly Enterprise, Katana Advantage) carry monthlyUsd=null. Promotional prices noted in plan notes; regular monthly used as monthlyUsd. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Zoho Inventory
vendors.provenance: Fetched zoho.com/us/inventory/pricing/ (page renders EUR on /us/; USD prices corroborated via Capterra and G2 — per-organization flat pricing). Monthly: Standard $39, Professional $99, Premium $159, Enterprise $299. Annual ~20-26% off: $29/$79/$129/$249.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 50 orders/month, 1 user, 2 locations. Perpetual free tier, no time limit.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: 500 orders/month, 2 users, 2 locations. Per-organization (not per-user). $29/month billed annually ($348/yr).

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: 3,000 orders/month, 2 users, 4 locations. Serial/batch tracking, vendor portal. $79/month billed annually.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 7,500 orders/month, 2 users, 6 locations, 2,000 bins/location. $129/month billed annually.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 15,000 orders/month, 7 users, 10 locations, 5,000 bins/location. $249/month billed annually.

keyFeatures: Perpetual free tier with real order processing
SOC 2 + GDPR compliant (per-product; HIPAA/BAA not offered for Inventory)
Deep Zoho ecosystem integration (CRM, Books, Analytics)
Per-organization flat pricing with add-on marketplace for users, orders, locations
bestFor: SMBs on Zoho ecosystem
Budget-conscious teams needing multi-channel
Businesses wanting free tier before committing
enrichment.provenance: Prices from official Zoho US pricing page (EUR-rendered; USD corroborated via Capterra/G2 — per-organization flat). HIPAA removed: not a BAA product for Inventory. SOC2/GDPR from zoho.com/compliance.html.
